owner_constraint: Use only the existing photo and audio
purpose: Compare restrained generated head and hand motion without post-render head correction
prompt: Locked-off, eye-level medium shot. He speaks matter-of-factly with natural blinks and tiny head adjustments; his forearms stay supported on the desk while his fingers make small, relaxed movements close to the tabletop.
seed_policy: Record independent seeds only if exposed; otherwise record independent request IDs. Identical numbers across models do not establish matched randomness.
review_order: Verify exact result identity and full duration
Full clip 1x with audio against Q and M's accepted quality
Muted full playback for distracting motion
failure_signals: Conspicuous head dip or forward thrust
Lip mismatch, including after the pause
stop_rule: Stop after four initial results. If none is owner-acceptable, no further prompting, warping or model expansion without reassessing the method.
longer_validation: Only after an acceptable short result; use a longer contiguous excerpt of the existing locked narration and recheck full motion.
execution_preconditions: Verify actual authenticated model access and live schema
Render authority for this benchmark must be resolved; this file does not submit or authorize charges
